trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap stages in order so the long count trophies run in the background while you play the story, and save 100% Completion for last. No step here goes beyond the official description.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so it pops naturally as you start playing and cannot be missed in a normal playthrough. The official description names only the mission; anything beyond that has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its story missions in order. Story progress only — there is no side requirement. The official description names only the chapter; the mission list inside it has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its story missions in order. Story progress only — there is no side requirement. The official description names only the chapter; the mission list inside it has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its story missions in order. Story progress only — there is no side requirement. The official description names only the chapter; the mission list inside it has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its story missions in order. Story progress only — there is no side requirement. The official description names only the chapter; the mission list inside it has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Finish the game and the trophy pops when the last mission ends. The official description does not name the mission, and its name has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Play it through to the end; the official description names only the mission. Where it sits in the chapter order and what it asks you to do have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story. Play it through to the end; the official description names only the mission. Where it sits in the chapter order and what it asks you to do have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story. Play it through to the end; the official description names only the mission. Where it sits in the chapter order and what it asks you to do have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners when it appears in the story. Play it through to the end; the official description names only the mission. Where it sits in the chapter order and what it asks you to do have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story. Play it through to the end; the official description names only the mission. Where it sits in the chapter order and what it asks you to do have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story. Play it through to the end; the official description names only the mission. Where it sits in the chapter order and what it asks you to do have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion. This is the long one: it folds in the story, the stranger strands, activities and collectibles, so treat it as the final cleanup goal and use this tracker's checklist to see what is left. The exact 100% checklist is not in the official description and has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts build up across normal driving — jumps, near misses and airtime — so start early and let the count grow while you do everything else instead of grinding it in one sitting. The official description gives only the total; which moves count as a stunt has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade and the rest — rather than grinding one of them. The official description does not list the activity types, and the full list has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every challenge at the range and aim for gold on each; the count of 42 comes from the PSN trophy list. Which weapons and drills each challenge uses has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations listed by the PSN trophy list. The exact locations are not named in the official description and have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win twenty distinct races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so race variety matters more than volume. The race list itself is not in the official description and has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge against Cal and out-fish him. Where and when Cal appears is not in the official description and has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game through to completion — one finished game is all it takes. Which arcade games exist and where the arcades are have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's strand of missions to its last one; the strand unlocks through the story and side content. When Andy's missions appear and what they ask have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand of missions to its last one; the strand unlocks through the story and side content. When Kenton's missions appear and what they ask have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand of missions to its last one; the strand unlocks through the story and side content. When Billy's missions appear and what they ask have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Find and finish eight stranger mission strands scattered across the state. Strands unlock as you explore, so watch for stranger markers on the map between story missions and clear them as you go.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand of missions to its last one; the strand unlocks through the story and side content. When Randy's missions appear and what they ask have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand of missions to its last one; the strand unlocks through the story and side content. When Tyrone's missions appear and what they ask have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Visit all 18 meditation spots listed by the PSN trophy list and meditate at each one. The spot locations are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track down the unique animal Bret asks for and hunt it. Which animal it is and where it roams are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards across Leonida until three full sets are complete. Card locations are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game, so pick cards up whenever you see them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. The locations are not listed in the official description and have not been checked in the game — spread the habit across the whole map as you travel.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenges — any fifty count toward the total, so clear the easy ones first and let the rest accumulate. Which challenges exist is not in the official description and has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together. Do it deliberately in free roam rather than during a mission, so a failed attempt can simply be retried. This is a one-shot feat: plan it before you start.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level alive between them — do not lose the cops or get caught in between. Plan a route with three shops close together before you start, and treat it as a single run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles; new discoveries count as you encounter them across Leonida. Variety is the whole job — hop into anything new you pass instead of sticking to one favourite car.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy fight with grouped enemies, and save beforehand if the game allows it so a miss costs nothing.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the wording points to commandeering a departure rather than taking a scheduled flight. The exact method has not been checked in the game, so treat any specific trick as unverified until a sourced guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The official description is a joke, not an instruction — the exact requirement has not been checked in the game. Expect it to involve Rhino tanks in combat; treat any specific method as unverified and watch for a sourced confirmation before chasing it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the robbery, stay out of sight, and leave without ever being spotted. If you are detected, the attempt fails — slip away and retry rather than finishing loud.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and escape cleanly after each one. The vault locations are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game, so note each vault you find for the next run.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck, rob it, and escape. Truck routes and spawn spots are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state listed by the PSN trophy list. The area list is not in the official description and has not been checked in the game — use the in-game map to spot regions you have not visited yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs listed by the PSN trophy list. Which operations belong to which gang is not in the official description and has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact bar is not named in the official description and has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle out through a showroom — the classic smash-and-grab exit. The exact showroom is not named in the official description and has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The description names the alley; anything beyond that has not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description is deliberately vague — the trigger is not stated, and it has not been checked in the game. Treat this as a watch-for-it trophy and check back if a sourced guide confirms what sets it off.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The PSN trophy list tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy, tied to choices you make along the way. The exact choices are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game, so keep playing and choosing — the count grows with your decisions.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed on a second try at something — the description hints the trophy comes from failing once and then succeeding. The exact event has not been checked in the game, so do not force it; it will likely pop during normal play.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — the description points to an odd, probably rare or hidden event somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger has not been checked in the game; explore odd corners of the map and watch for it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Practice the timing in free roam where a miss costs nothing, and line the target up before you swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is earned. The contacts and the rates are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game — bank the bills whenever you get them.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across shops — it accumulates over the whole game, so it will likely pop during normal play and cleanup shopping. Big purchases late in the game finish it off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all eight garage properties listed by the PSN trophy list across Leonida. Property locations and prices are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. The app's exact steps are not in the official description and have not been checked in the game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
